bonus.text: The Rokumeikan opened on 28 November 1883 with a gala for about 1,200 guests. Foreign residents of Tokyo were hired to teach the dances.
Today’s Japan Ballroom Dance Federation grew out of the Nippon League of Competitive Ballroom Dancing, which led Japanese ballroom for 50 years.
Ballroom even has its own manga: Welcome to the Ballroom by Tomo Takeuchi, running since 2011 and turned into an anime by Production I.G in 2017.
